99 Adrias {ad-ree'-as}

源於 Adria (靠近其海岸的一個地方); 專有地名

欽定本 - Adria 1; 1

亞底亞 = "無林之地"
1) 亞得里亞海, 亞底亞, 介在希臘和義大利之間的海域 (#徒27:27|)

from Adria (a place near its shore);; n pr loc

AV - Adria 1; 1

Adriatic = "without wood"
1) Adriatic Sea, Adrias, the sea between Greece and Italy
